integrity: Analytic case classification and independent finite enumeration of complete sixteen-word terminal-letter component. Direct tests do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact four-letter, variable-length, at-most-one leading deletion model. Labeled codebooks, not equivalence classes. Ranking length is a combinatorial cost rather than experimental synthesis expense. Possible equivalence to unindexed suffix-tree packing enumerations remains a literature risk.
title: Complete quaternary single-tail-deletion optimal-code spectrum and minimum ranking length
